name: cert-paste-check
title: Cert Paste Check
description: Stops a broken TLS install by telling a certificate from a private key from a CSR as they are pasted, and catching a chain out of order or missing its intermediate, an expired or soon-expiring certificate, a domain the SANs don't cover (wildcard and CN-only traps included), a self-signed certificate in production and a private key that doesn't match, with one-tap reorder and remove fixes.

mistakes: private key does not match cert
